sources.title: Pine532/chameleon-layout-critic · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 113-weight linear model that scores a finished banner layout and is used to choose among near-equal candidates produced by the Chameleon resize engine. It was distilled from the pairwise verdicts of a strong vision-language model ("the judge") and runs on numpy alone, offline, in about 2 ms per ...

sources.title: Pine532/chameleon-layout-generator · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 6,600-weight MLP that, given the analysed layout of a design and a target canvas size, predicts the box each content unit should occupy on the target. The Chameleon resize engine turns the prediction into extra candidate layouts (learned, learned:<rung>); the engine's text fitting, hard checks ...
